# Hacker News

> > Social news aggregator focused on computer science, entrepreneurship, and technology, operated by Y Combinator.

Hacker News is a community-driven platform where users submit, vote on, and discuss stories about technology, startups, programming, and science. The site features discussions on companies like Meta Platforms and xAI, AI models like Claude (Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6), and topics ranging from NSA surveillance to app store regulation.

## Key Topics

- Y Combinator
- Tech news aggregation
- Startup community
- Artificial Intelligence (Claude, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6)
- Meta Platforms
- xAI and Elon Musk
- Privacy and surveillance (NSA, Section 702)
- App Store regulation
- Programming and software development
- Open source projects
- YouTube and content platforms
- Technology policy
- Channel Surfer
- TUI Studio
- Community discussion

## Main Pages

- [Hacker News Homepage](https://news.ycombinator.com/): Main landing page featuring current top stories, newest submissions, and community discussions on technology and startups

- [Front Page Archive - March 13, 2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/front?day=&birth=manx): Historical snapshot of the front page from March 13, 2026
